message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_19723",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":231,"var":"ihbytes","code":"cmapbytes = offset - BMP_FHBYTES - ihbytes;","role":"source","note":"ihbytes is read from attacker-controlled file data, used to compute colormap size"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":232,"var":"cmapEntries","code":"cmapEntries = cmapbytes / sizeof(RGBA_QUAD);","role":"intermediate","note":"cmapEntries derived from attacker-controlled ihbytes, may exceed valid colormap size for given depth"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":235,"var":"cmapEntries","code":"if (cmapEntries > L_MAX_ALLOWED_NUM_COLORS)","role":"root_cause","note":"Missing check that cmapEntries <= (1 << depth); only checks against 256 but for depth=1 max should be 2"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":269,"var":"cmap","code":"cmap = pixcmapCreate(L_MIN(d, 8));","role":"intermediate","note":"Creates colormap with nalloc = 1<<depth (e.g., 2 for depth=1), but cmapEntries exceeds this"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":272,"var":"cmap->n","code":"cmap->n = L_MIN(cmapEntries, 256);","role":"intermediate","note":"Sets cmap->n to cmapEntries (e.g., 4) but nalloc remains 2, creating inconsistency"},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":364,"var":"pix1","code":"pix1 = pixRemoveColormap(pix, REMOVE_CMAP_TO_BINARY);","role":"intermediate","note":"pixRemoveColormap operates on inconsistent colormap (n > nalloc), causes internal realloc/free"},
   {"step":7,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":365,"var":"pix","code":"pixDestroy(&pix);","role":"intermediate","note":"Destroys original pix which frees the colormap and its array"},
   {"step":8,"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":366,"var":"pix","code":"pix = pix1;","role":"sink","note":"If pixRemoveColormap returned pointer into freed pix or its internals, pix1 is a dangling pointer causing heap-use-after-free on subsequent access"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":231,"operands":["ihbytes","cmapbytes"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":235,"operands":["cmapEntries","1 << depth"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"cmapEntries","right":"1 << depth"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":366,"operands":["pix","pix1"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"pix1","right":"NULL"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":231,"operands":["ihbytes"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":232,"operands":["cmapEntries"]},
      "type":"data","via":["cmapbytes"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":232,"operands":["cmapEntries"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":272,"operands":["cmap->n"]},
      "type":"data","via":["cmapEntries"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":272,"operands":["cmap->n"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/bmpio.c","function":"pixReadMemBmp","line":366,"operands":["pix1"]},
      "type":"data","via":["cmap"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
